lines.en: evidence is there of a ghost?
A public house which was recently bought by Mr.Ian Thompson is up for sale.
lines.zh: 汤普森先生最近才买的一个小酒店现在又要卖出去。

lines.en: Mr.Thompson is going to sell it because it is haunted .
lines.zh: 汤普森先生之所以想卖它，是因为那里常闹鬼。

lines.en: He told me that he could not go to sleep one night because he heard a strange noise coming from the bar.
lines.zh: 他告诉我有天夜里他怎么也睡不着，因为他听到酒吧里传来一阵奇怪的响声。

lines.en: The next morning, he found that the doors had been blocked by chairs and the furniture had been moved.
lines.zh: 第二天早上，他发现酒吧间的门被椅子堵上了，家具也被挪动过。

lines.en: Though Mr.Thompson had turned the lights off before he went to bed, they were on in the morning.
lines.zh: 虽然汤普森临睡觉时把灯关了，但早晨灯却都亮着。

lines.en: He also said that he had found five empty whisky bottles which the ghost must have drunk the night before.
lines.zh: 他还说他发现了5只空的威士忌瓶子，肯定是鬼魂昨天晚上喝的。

lines.en: When I suggested that some villagers must have come in for a free drink, Mr.Thompson shook his head.
lines.zh: 当我暗示说一定是村里有些人来喝不花钱的酒时，汤普森先生摇了摇头。

lines.en: The villagers have told him that they will not accept the pub even if he gives it away.
lines.zh: 村里的人已经告诉他，即使他把小酒店白送人，他们也不要。

translation: 汤普森先生最近才买的一个小酒店现在又要卖出去。

他还说他发现了5只空的威士忌瓶子，肯定是鬼魂昨天晚上喝的。
